title: core: add 64 bit unique ID to every core surface
body:
- Expose that ID as the environment variable GHOSTTY_SURFACE_ID to processes running in Ghostty surfaces.
- Add a function to the core app to search for surfaces by ID.
- ID is randomly generated, it has no other meaning other than as a unique identifier for the surface. The ID also cannot be zero as that is used to indicate a null ID in some situations.
